attempts.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (4096-bit RSA, self-signed, 10-year validity) on node1, installed it as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates, and verified trust with openssl. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot, polled until SSH returned, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified the CA cert and its trust status survived the reboot.
